similarly for slaying the commander-in-chief, and [a reward] for crushing elephants and the like. / Alternatively, opponents on horses, chariots, and elephants should fight their counterparts,
[...]
1. "Free of gravel, with accessible rocks" in ms. ja.
2. "What indeed is to be given" in mss. gha. and ña.
[Page 379]

241.s:
yathā bhavedasaṃbādho vyāyāmavinivartane /
asaṅkareṇa yuddheran saṅkaraḥ saṅkulāvahaḥ //
241.d:
यथा भवेदसंबाधो व्यायामविनिवर्तने /
असङ्करेण युद्धेरन् सङ्करः सङ्कुलावहः //
241.m: so that there may be no congestion in engagement and withdrawal. / They should fight without intermingling, for confusion brings chaotic turmoil.

241.s:
mahāsaṅkulayuddheṣu saṃśrayeranmataṅgajaṃ /
aśvasya pratiyoddhāro bhaveyuḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ //
241.d:
महासङ्कुलयुद्धेषु संश्रयेरन्मतङ्गजं /
अश्वस्य प्रतियोद्धारो भवेयुः पुरुषास्त्रयः //
241.m: In massive melee combats, they should take shelter behind an elephant. / There should be three men as combatants against a horse;

241.s:
iti kalpyāstrayaścāśvā vidheyāḥ kuñjarasya tu /
pādagopā bhaveyuś ca puruṣā daśa pañca ca //
241.d:
इति कल्प्यास्त्रयश्चाश्वा विधेयाः कुञ्जरस्य तु /
पादगोपा भवेयुश् च पुरुषा दश पञ्च च //
241.m: thus three horses are to be assigned, arranged for an elephant. / And there should be fifteen men as foot-guards [for an elephant].

241.s:
vidhānamiti nāgasya vihitaṃ syandanasya ca /
anīkamiti vijñeyamiti kalpyā nava dvipāḥ //
241.d:
विधानमिति नागस्य विहितं स्यन्दनस्य च /
अनीकमिति विज्ञेयमिति कल्प्या नव द्विपाः //
241.m: Such is the rule prescribed for an elephant and also for a chariot. / This is to be known as a unit (*anīka*), and nine elephants are to be arranged in this way.

241.s:
tathānīkasya randhrantu pañcadhā ca pracakṣate /
ityanīkavibhagena sthāpayed vyūhasampadaḥ //
241.d:
तथानीकस्य रन्ध्रन्तु पञ्चधा च प्रचक्षते /
इत्यनीकविभगेन स्थापयेद् व्यूहसम्पदः //
241.m: Likewise, they declare the division (*randhra*) of an *anīka* to be fivefold. / According to this division of the *anīka*, one should establish the assets of the array (*vyūha*).

241.s:
urasyakakṣapakṣāṃstu kalpyānetān pracakṣate /
uraḥkakṣau ca pakṣau ca madhyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ pratigrahaḥ //
241.d:
उरस्यकक्षपक्षांस्तु कल्प्यानेतान् प्रचक्षते /
उरःकक्षौ च पक्षौ च मध्यं पृष्ठं प्रतिग्रहः //
241.m: They declare these to be arranged: the center (*urasya*), flanks (*kakṣa*), and wings (*pakṣa*). / The center, the two flanks, the two wings, the middle, the rear, and the reserve,

241.s:
koṭī ca vyūhaśāstrajñaiḥ saptāṅgo vyūha ucyate /
urasyakakṣapakṣāstu vyūho 'yaṃ sapratigrahaḥ //
241.d:
कोटी च व्यूहशास्त्रज्ञैः सप्ताङ्गो व्यूह उच्यते /
उरस्यकक्षपक्षास्तु व्यूहो ऽयं सप्रतिग्रहः //
241.m: and the two tips (*koṭī*): by the knowers of the science of battle-arrays, an array is said to have seven limbs. / The array consisting of center, flanks, and wings is provided with a reserve.

241.s:
guroreṣa ca śukrasya kakṣābhyāṃ parivarjitaḥ /
tiṣṭheyuḥ senāpatayaḥ pravīraiḥ puruṣair vṛtāḥ //
241.d:
गुरोरेष च शुक्रस्य कक्षाभ्यां परिवर्जितः /
तिष्ठेयुः सेनापतयः प्रवीरैः पुरुषैर् वृताः //
241.m: According to Guru [Bṛhaspati] and Śukra, this [array] is devoid of the two flanks. / The army commanders, surrounded by champion warriors, should stand [there],

241.s:
abhedena ca yudhyeran rakṣeyuś ca parasparaṃ /
madhyavyūhe phalgu sainyaṃ yuddhavastu jaghanyataḥ //
241.d:
अभेदेन च युध्येरन् रक्षेयुश् च परस्परं /
मध्यव्यूहे फल्गु सैन्यं युद्धवस्तु जघन्यतः //
241.m: and fight with undivided unity, protecting one another. / In the middle array should be the weak troops; the combat equipment should be placed at the rear.

241.s:
yuddhaṃ hi nāyakaprāṇaṃ hanyate tadanāyakaṃ /
urasi sthāpayennāgān pracaṇḍān kakṣayo rathān //
241.d:
युद्धं हि नायकप्राणं हन्यते तदनायकं /
उरसि स्थापयेन्नागान् प्रचण्डान् कक्षयो रथान् //
241.m: For battle has the leader as its breath of life; without a leader, it is destroyed. / One should place ferocious elephants in the center, and chariots on the two flanks,

241.s:
hayāṃś ca pakṣayorvyūho madhyabhedī prakīrtitaḥ /
madhyadeśe hayānīkaṃ rathānīkañca kakṣayoḥ //
241.d:
हयांश् च पक्षयोर्व्यूहो मध्यभेदी प्रकीर्तितः /
मध्यदेशे हयानीकं रथानीकञ्च कक्षयोः //
241.m: and horses on the two wings: this array is proclaimed as "center-piercing" (*madhyabhedin*). / The horse division in the center, the chariot division on the two flanks,

241.s:
pakṣayoś ca gajānīkaṃ vyūhontarbhedyayaṃ smṛtaḥ /
:p 380
rathasthāne hayān dadyāt padātīṃś ca hayaśrāye //
241.d:
पक्षयोश् च गजानीकं व्यूहोन्तर्भेद्ययं स्मृतः /
:प् 380
रथस्थाने हयान् दद्यात् पदातींश् च हयश्राये //
241.m:
and the elephant division on the two wings: this array is known as "interior-piercing" (*antarbhedya*).
[Page 380]
In place of chariots, one may assign horses; and infantry in support of the horses.

241.s:
rathābhāve tu dviradān vyūhe sarvatra dāpayet /
yadi syāddaṇḍabāhulyamābādhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ //
241.d:
रथाभावे तु द्विरदान् व्यूहे सर्वत्र दापयेत् /
यदि स्याद्दण्डबाहुल्यमाबाधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः //
241.m: In the absence of chariots, however, one should station elephants everywhere in the array. / If there is an abundance of the staff (*daṇḍa*) formation, it is declared an obstruction.

241.s:
maṇḍalāṃsaṃhato bhogo daṇḍāste bahudhā śṛṇu /
tiryagvṛttistu daṇḍaḥ syād bhogo 'nyāvṛttireva ca //
241.d:
मण्डलांसंहतो भोगो दण्डास्ते बहुधा शृणु /
तिर्यग्वृत्तिस्तु दण्डः स्याद् भोगो ऽन्यावृत्तिरेव च //
241.m: The circle (*maṇḍala*), the detached (*asaṃhata*), the serpent (*bhoga*), and the staff (*daṇḍa*) formations: hear about them in detail. / The staff moves transversely, while the serpent formation advances in another movement.

241.s:
maṇḍalaḥ sarvatovṛttiḥ pṛthagvṛttirasaṃhataḥ /
pradaro dṛḍhako 'sahyaḥ cāpo vai kukṣireva ca //
241.d:
मण्डलः सर्वतोवृत्तिः पृथग्वृत्तिरसंहतः /
प्रदरो दृढको ऽसह्यः चापो वै कुक्षिरेव च //
241.m: The circle moves in all directions, and the detached moves separately. / The *pradara* (cleaver), *dṛḍhaka* (firm), *asahya* (irresistible), the bow (*cāpa*), the flank (*kukṣi*),

241.s:
pratiṣṭhaḥ supratiṣṭhaś ca śyeno vijayasañjayau /
viśālo vijayaḥ śūcī sthūṇākarṇacamūmukhau //
241.d:
प्रतिष्ठः सुप्रतिष्ठश् च श्येनो विजयसञ्जयौ /
विशालो विजयः शूची स्थूणाकर्णचमूमुखौ //
241.m: *pratiṣṭha* (firmly based), *supratiṣṭha* (well-founded), the hawk (*śyena*), the *vijaya* (victory) and *sañjaya* (complete victory), / *viśāla* (wide), *vijaya*, the needle (*sūcī*), the pillar-eared (*sthūṇākarṇa*), and the army-front (*camūmukha*),

241.s:
sarpāsyo valayaś caiva daṇḍa daṇḍabhedāś ca durjayāḥ /
atikrāntaḥ pratikrāntaḥ kakṣābhyāñcaikakṣapakṣataḥ //
241.d:
सर्पास्यो वलयश् चैव दण्ड दण्डभेदाश् च दुर्जयाः /
अतिक्रान्तः प्रतिक्रान्तः कक्षाभ्याञ्चैकक्षपक्षतः //
241.m: the snake-mouthed (*sarpāsya*), the ring (*valaya*), and the staff (*daṇḍa*)—these varieties of the staff array are difficult to conquer. / The advanced (*atikrānta*) and the counter-advanced (*pratikrānta*), by means of the two flanks or by one flank and wing;

241.s:
atikrāntastu pakṣābhyāṃ trayo 'nye tadviparyaye /
pakṣorasyair atikrāntaḥ pratiṣṭho 'nyo viparyayaḥ //
241.d:
अतिक्रान्तस्तु पक्षाभ्यां त्रयो ऽन्ये तद्विपर्यये /
पक्षोरस्यैर् अतिक्रान्तः प्रतिष्ठो ऽन्यो विपर्ययः //
241.m: the one advanced by the two wings, and three others of the contrary nature; / the *pratiṣṭha* advanced by wings and center, and the other is its opposite;

241.s:
sthūṇāpakṣo dhanuḥpakṣo dvisthūṇo daṇḍa ūrdhvagaḥ /
dviguṇontastvatikrāntapakṣo 'nyasya viparyayaḥ //
241.d:
स्थूणापक्षो धनुःपक्षो द्विस्थूणो दण्ड ऊर्ध्वगः /
द्विगुणोन्तस्त्वतिक्रान्तपक्षो ऽन्यस्य विपर्ययः //
241.m: the pillar-winged (*sthūṇāpakṣa*), the bow-winged (*dhanuḥpakṣa*), the double-pillared (*dvisthūṇa*), the staff pointing upward (*daṇḍa ūrdhvaga*), / the double-interior, and the one whose wings are advanced, and the opposite of the other;

241.s:
dvicaturdaṇḍa ity ete jñeyā lakṣaṇataḥ kramāt /
gomūtrikāhisañcārīśakaṭo makaras tathā //
241.d:
द्विचतुर्दण्ड इत्य् एते ज्ञेया लक्षणतः क्रमात् /
गोमूत्रिकाहिसञ्चारीशकटो मकरस् तथा //
241.m: the double and quadruple staff: these are to be known successively by their characteristics. / The cow's urine course (*gomūtrikā*), the serpent's motion (*ahisañcārin*), the cart (*śakaṭa*), and the crocodile (*makara*),

241.s:
bhogabhedāḥ samākhyātās tathā pariplavaṅgakaḥ /
daṇḍapakṣau yugārasyaḥ śakaṭastadviparyaye //
241.d:
भोगभेदाः समाख्यातास् तथा परिप्लवङ्गकः /
दण्डपक्षौ युगारस्यः शकटस्तद्विपर्यये //
241.m: are declared varieties of the serpent (*bhoga*) array, as well as the leaping monkey (*pariplavaṅgaka*). / The yoke-faced staff-winged array, and the cart is the reverse of it.

241.s:
makaro vyatikīrṇaś ca śeṣaḥ kuñjararājibhiḥ /
maṇḍalavyūhabhedau tu sarvatobhadradurjayau //
241.d:
मकरो व्यतिकीर्णश् च शेषः कुञ्जरराजिभिः /
मण्डलव्यूहभेदौ तु सर्वतोभद्रदुर्जयौ //
241.m: The crocodile is scattered, and the remainder consists of lines of elephants. / The two varieties of the circle array (*maṇḍalavyūha*) are the *sarvatobhadra* (auspicious on all sides) and the *durjaya* (unconquerable);

241.s:
aṣṭānīko dvitīyastu prathamaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ /
ardhacandraka ūrdhvāṅgo vajrabhedāstu saṃhateḥ //
:p 381
241.d:
अष्टानीको द्वितीयस्तु प्रथमः सर्वतोमुखः /
अर्धचन्द्रक ऊर्ध्वाङ्गो वज्रभेदास्तु संहतेः //
:प् 381
241.m:
the second has eight units (*aṣṭānīka*), while the first faces all directions (*sarvatomukha*). / The crescent (*ardhacandraka*), the upright (*ūrdhvāṅga*), and varieties of the thunderbolt (*vajra*) belong to the compacted (*saṃhata*) group.
[Page 381]

241.s:
tathā karkaṭaśṛṅgī ca kākapādau ca godhikā /
tricatuḥsainyānāṃ jñeyā ākārabhedataḥ //
241.d:
तथा कर्कटशृङ्गी च काकपादौ च गोधिका /
त्रिचतुःसैन्यानां ज्ञेया आकारभेदतः //
241.m: Likewise, the crab-horned (*karkaṭaśṛṅgī*), the crow's foot (*kākapāda*), and the monitor lizard (*godhikā*) / are to be known by the differences in shape among forces of three and four divisions.

241.s:
daṇḍasya syuḥ saptadaśa vyūhā dvau maṇḍalasya ca /
asaṅghātasya ṣaṭ pañca bhogasyaiva tu saṅgare //
241.d:
दण्डस्य स्युः सप्तदश व्यूहा द्वौ मण्डलस्य च /
असङ्घातस्य षट् पञ्च भोगस्यैव तु सङ्गरे //
241.m: There are seventeen arrays of the staff type, two of the circle, / six of the detached type, and five of the serpent type in battle.

241.s:
pakṣādīnāmathaikena hatvā śeṣaiḥ parikṣipet /
urasā vā samāhatya koṭibhyāṃ pariveṣṭayet(1) //
241.d:
पक्षादीनामथैकेन हत्वा शेषैः परिक्षिपेत् /
उरसा वा समाहत्य कोटिभ्यां परिवेष्टयेत्(1) //
241.m: Striking with one of the limbs such as the wing, one should encircle with the rest; / or striking with the center, one should surround with both tips.

241.s:
pare koṭī samākramya pakṣābhyāmapratigrahāt /
koṭibhyāñjaghanaṃ hanyādurasā ca prapīḍayet //
241.d:
परे कोटी समाक्रम्य पक्षाभ्यामप्रतिग्रहात् /
कोटिभ्याञ्जघनं हन्यादुरसा च प्रपीडयेत् //
241.m: Having attacked the enemy's tips with both wings from the non-reserve force, / one should strike their rear with the tips and crush them with the center.

241.s:
yataḥ phalgu yato bhinnaṃ yataścānyair adhiṣṭhitaṃ /
tataścāribalaṃ hanyādātmanaścopavṛṃhayet //
241.d:
यतः फल्गु यतो भिन्नं यतश्चान्यैर् अधिष्ठितं /
ततश्चारिबलं हन्यादात्मनश्चोपवृंहयेत् //
241.m: Where the enemy's force is weak, where it is broken, and where it is commanded by others, / from there one should strike the enemy's army and augment one's own.

241.s:
sāraṃ dviguṇasāreṇa phalgusāreṇa pīḍayet /
saṃhatañca gajānīkaiḥ pracaṇḍair dārayedbalaṃ //
241.d:
सारं द्विगुणसारेण फल्गुसारेण पीडयेत् /
संहतञ्च गजानीकैः प्रचण्डैर् दारयेद्बलं //
241.m: One should press the core force with twice the core, and weak troops with the core; / and one should split compacted troops with fierce divisions of elephants.

241.s:
syāt kakṣapakṣorasyaś ca vartamānastu daṇḍakaḥ /
tatra prayogo ḍaṇḍasya sthānanturyeṇa darśayet //
241.d:
स्यात् कक्षपक्षोरस्यश् च वर्तमानस्तु दण्डकः /
तत्र प्रयोगो डण्डस्य स्थानन्तुर्येण दर्शयेत् //
241.m: The staff array is that which consists of flanks, wings, and a center. / There, one should demonstrate the deployment of the staff in immediate succession of positions.

241.s:
syāddaṇḍasamapakṣābhyāmatikrānto dṛḍhaḥ smṛtaḥ /
bhavetsa pakṣakakṣābhyāmatikrāntaḥ pradārakaḥ //
241.d:
स्याद्दण्डसमपक्षाभ्यामतिक्रान्तो दृढः स्मृतः /
भवेत्स पक्षकक्षाभ्यामतिक्रान्तः प्रदारकः //
241.m: The *dṛḍha* (firm) is known as having wings level with the staff, while advanced; / the *pradāraka* (cleaver) is that which is advanced with both wings and flanks.

241.s:
kakṣābhyāñca pratikrāntavyūho 'sahyaḥ smṛto yathā /
kakṣapakṣāvadhaḥ sthapyorasyaiḥ kāntaś ca khātakaḥ //
241.d:
कक्षाभ्याञ्च प्रतिक्रान्तव्यूहो ऽसह्यः स्मृतो यथा /
कक्षपक्षावधः स्थप्योरस्यैः कान्तश् च खातकः //
241.m: The array counter-advanced with the two flanks is known as the *asahya* (irresistible). / Having placed wings and flanks low, the advanced center forms the *khātaka*.

241.s:
dvau daṇḍau balayaḥ prokto kāntaś ca khātakaḥ /
durjayaś caturvalayaḥ śatrorbalavimardanaḥ //
241.d:
द्वौ दण्डौ बलयः प्रोक्तो कान्तश् च खातकः /
दुर्जयश् चतुर्वलयः शत्रोर्बलविमर्दनः //
241.m: Two staffs form what is called the circle (*valaya*), and advanced is the *khātaka*; / the fourfold ring is the *durjaya* (unconquerable), which crushes the enemy's force.

241.s:
kakṣapakṣaurasyair bhogo viṣayaṃ parivartayan /
:n
1 koṭibhyāṃ parikalpayediti gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 382
sarpacārī gomūtrikā śarkaṭaḥ śakaṭākṛtiḥ //
241.d:
कक्षपक्षौरस्यैर् भोगो विषयं परिवर्तयन् /
:न्
1 कोटिभ्यां परिकल्पयेदिति घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 382
सर्पचारी गोमूत्रिका शर्कटः शकटाकृतिः //
241.m:
The serpent array (*bhoga*), with flanks, wings, and center turning across the ground,
[...]
1. "One should arrange with both tips" in mss. gha. and ña.
[Page 382]
moves like a snake (*sarpacārī*), [in the pattern of] cow's urine (*gomūtrikā*), and the cart (*śakaṭa*) is in the shape of a cart.

241.s:
viparyayo 'maraḥ proktaḥ sarvaśatruvimardakaḥ /
syāt kakṣapakṣorasyānāmekībhāvastu maṇḍalaḥ //
241.d:
विपर्ययो ऽमरः प्रोक्तः सर्वशत्रुविमर्दकः /
स्यात् कक्षपक्षोरस्यानामेकीभावस्तु मण्डलः //
241.m: The reverse of it is called *amara* (immortal), which crushes all enemies. / The unification of flanks, wings, and center constitutes the circle (*maṇḍala*).

241.s:
cakrapadmādayo bhedā maṇḍalasya prabhedakāḥ /
evañca sarvatobhadro vajrākṣavarakākavat //
241.d:
चक्रपद्मादयो भेदा मण्डलस्य प्रभेदकाः /
एवञ्च सर्वतोभद्रो वज्राक्षवरकाकवत् //
241.m: The wheel (*cakra*), lotus (*padma*), and others are subdivisions of the circle. / And likewise, the *sarvatobhadra* is like the dice-box or crow-like array.

241.s:
ardhacandraś ca śṛṅgāṭo hy acalo nāmarūpataḥ(1) /
vyūhā yathāsukhaṃ karyāḥ śatrūṇāṃ balavāraṇāḥ //
241.d:
अर्धचन्द्रश् च शृङ्गाटो ह्य् अचलो नामरूपतः(1) /
व्यूहा यथासुखं कर्याः शत्रूणां बलवारणाः //
241.m: The half-moon (ardhacandra), the triangle (śṛṅgāṭa), and the immovable (acala) [are defined] by their name and form. / Formations should be made at will to ward off the army of enemies.

241.s:
agnir uvācarāmastu rāvaṇaṃ hatvā ayodhyāṃ prāptavān dvija /
rāmoktanītyendrajitaṃ hatavāṃllakṣmaṇaḥ purā //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe rāmoktarājanītirnāma
ekacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

daṇḍādikatipayavyūhānāṃ vinduvinyāsaistattannāmasamīpe

241.d:
अग्निर् उवाचरामस्तु रावणं हत्वा अयोध्यां प्राप्तवान् द्विज /
रामोक्तनीत्येन्द्रजितं हतवांल्लक्ष्मणः पुरा //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे रामोक्तराजनीतिर्नाम
एकचत्वारिंशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 अस्मल्लब्धपुस्तकनां मध्ये क.. ज.. चिह्नितपुस्त्रकद्वये
दण्डादिकतिपयव्यूहानां विन्दुविन्यासैस्तत्तन्नामसमीपे
आकृतयः प्रदर्शिताः , परन्तु ता अशुद्धा / ता
यथा,दण्डव्यूहस्य ??? / प्रदारकस्य ??? / दृढव्यूहस्य ??? /
असह्यव्यूहस्य ??? / खातकव्यूहस्य ??? / वलयव्यूहस्य ??? /
दुर्जयव्यूहस्य ??? / भोगव्यूहस्य ??? / गोमूत्रिकाव्यूहस्य ??? /
